task.description:
Write test specifications and tests for EPIC-3 scheduler changes (ISS-301, ISS-302, ISS-303).

## Required test specs
Create `tests/specs/ISS-301-skip-locked-queue.md`, `tests/specs/ISS-302-startup-sweep-lock.md`, `tests/specs/ISS-303-timer-dlq-routing.md`

## ISS-301 tests
- Unit test: `processNextDueTimer` does NOT call `pg_try_advisory_xact_lock` (verify absence)
- Unit test: when two workers race, SKIP LOCKED ensures only one fires (mock test or integration)
- Integration test: insert 2 due timers, run pollDueTimers concurrently from 2 goroutines, each fired exactly once

## ISS-302 tests  
- Unit tests for startup sweep lock protocol:
  - When lock acquired: sweep runs, lock released after
  - When lock NOT acquired: sweep skipped, is_startup_sweep set to false, polling continues
- isFiredLate: ensure existing tests still pass (they should — no changes)

## ISS-303 tests
- Unit test: after `max_timer_fire_retries` failed attempts, timer status = 'failed' and DLQ entry created
- Integration test (requires real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL):
  - Insert a timer for a non-existent instance (forces append event to fail)
  - Run pollDueTimers `max_timer_fire_retries` times
  - Assert timer.status = 'failed'
  - Assert dead_letter_queue row with item_type='TIMER' and source_ref=timer_id
- Unit test: `markTimerFailedInTx` SQL correctness (verify UPDATE + INSERT)

## Rules
- All integration tests must use real PostgreSQL (BPM_TEST_DB_URL)
- No mocks, no stubs
- Per-test UUIDs for all fixtures
- Tests must fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent
- No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests
acceptance_criteria: Test specs created for all 3 issues
ISS-301 tests verify SKIP LOCKED behavior
ISS-302 tests cover startup lock acquired/not-acquired paths
ISS-303 integration tests verify exhaustion → FAILED + DLQ
